_: Camera of docs/reference/cave-door.jpg (1024x572), solved by line tracing (scripts/fp/solve_camera.py, cross-checked by scripts/fp/fit_camera.py). three.js conventions: vertical fov in degrees, Euler YXZ, yaw 0 looks down -z and positive yaw turns toward -x, positive pitch looks up; eye in world units (block (x,y,z) fills [x-0.5,x+0.5] x [y,y+1] x [z-0.5,z+0.5]).
